accepted.s: The Fourteenth WTO Ministerial Conference (MC14), held in March 2026, took place at which of the following places?
accepted.x: WTO MC14 was held at Yaoundé, Cameroon, from 26 to 29 March 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the venue-based direct-recall method for international conferences.
accepted.sec: WTO/IMF/World Bank developments - ministerial conferences, quota reforms, lending

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding WTO MC14:
1. It ended without a ministerial declaration.
2. The e-commerce customs-duty moratorium lapsed on 31 March 2026.
3. A permanent solution on public stockholding for food security was adopted.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. No permanent solution on public stockholding was reached at MC14.
accepted.tq: Find the one false outcome in a group of closely related conference results.
accepted.sec: WTO/IMF/World Bank developments - ministerial conferences, quota reforms, lending

accepted.s: With reference to the WTO e-commerce customs-duty moratorium, which one of the following is correct?
o: It was replaced by the Fisheries Subsidies Agreement in 2025.
It was introduced in 2022 and made permanent in 2026.
It applies only to agricultural exports and was renewed at MC14.
It has prohibited customs duties on electronic transmissions since 1998 and lapsed on 31 March 2026.
accepted.x: The moratorium on customs duties on electronic transmissions had existed since 1998 and lapsed for the first time on 31 March 2026.
accepted.tq: Separate the exact subject, duration and outcome instead of relying on a familiar WTO term.
accepted.sec: WTO/IMF/World Bank developments - ministerial conferences, quota reforms, lending

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the Investment Facilitation for Development (IFD) proposal at WTO MC14?
o: It was rejected by the WTO Secretariat before the conference.
It was backed by 129 of 166 members but was not added to Annex 4 after India blocked it.
It was added to Annex 4 unanimously.
It was backed by 66 members and adopted as a plurilateral agreement.
accepted.x: Although 129 of the 166 members supported it, India blocked adding the IFD agreement to Annex 4.
accepted.tq: Check the difference between broad support and actual adoption.
accepted.sec: WTO/IMF/World Bank developments - ministerial conferences, quota reforms, lending

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?

1. MC9 — Bali — Peace Clause for food-security stockholding
2. MC12 — Geneva — Fisheries Subsidies Agreement, Phase 1
3. MC13 — Abu Dhabi — 26 February to 2 March 2024
4. MC14 — Yaoundé — 26 to 29 March 2026
accepted.x: All four pairs are correctly matched. MC9 was held in 2013, MC12 in 2022, MC13 in 2024 and MC14 in 2026.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure venue-year pair and verify each conference outcome.
accepted.sec: WTO/IMF/World Bank developments - ministerial conferences, quota reforms, lending

accepted.s:
Arrange the following WTO events in chronological order:
A. MC12 adopted Phase 1 of the Fisheries Subsidies Agreement.
B. MC9 adopted the Peace Clause for food-security stockholding.
C. MC14 was held at Yaoundé.
D. MC13 was held at Abu Dhabi.
accepted.x: The correct order is MC9 in 2013, MC12 in 2022, MC13 in 2024 and MC14 in 2026.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest and latest conferences first, then place the middle events by year.
accepted.sec: WTO/IMF/World Bank developments - ministerial conferences, quota reforms, lending

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about WTO Ministerial Conferences is correct?
o: It was created after the Doha Round was concluded.
It functions under the IMF and deals exclusively with exchange rates.
It is the WTO's highest body and meets at least once every two years under the Marrakesh Agreement.
It is an advisory body that meets once every five years.
accepted.x: The WTO Ministerial Conference is the organisation's highest decision-making body and meets at least every two years.
accepted.tq: Identify the authority and function of the institution rather than its latest event.
accepted.sec: WTO/IMF/World Bank developments - ministerial conferences, quota reforms, lending

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: Doha Round — concluded successfully before MC14
MC12 — Geneva — Fisheries Subsidies Agreement, Phase 1
accepted.x: The Doha Round has never concluded. The other three pairs are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Find the reversed or overstated conclusion in a list of familiar WTO facts.
accepted.sec: WTO/IMF/World Bank developments - ministerial conferences, quota reforms, lending

accepted.s: The BRICS New Delhi Declaration of September 2026 called for which of the following reforms?
o: A permanent ban on all WTO dispute settlement proceedings
Abolition of the IMF and World Bank
IMF and World Bank quota and voting reform and restoration of the WTO Appellate Body
Replacement of the WTO by a BRICS-only trade organisation
accepted.x: The declaration sought reform of IMF and World Bank quotas and voting, along with restoration of the two-tier WTO dispute-settlement system.
accepted.tq: Link a declaration with its specific institutional demands.
accepted.sec: WTO/IMF/World Bank developments - ministerial conferences, quota reforms, lending

accepted.s: The headquarters of the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) is located at:
accepted.x: UNEP is headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya.
accepted.tq: Use the headquarters-location association for international organisations.
accepted.sec: International organisation → headquarters + head (UN bodies, IMF, UNEP, FAO, UNESCO, WHO, WTO, ILO)

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: UNESCO is headquartered in Paris. WHO is in Geneva, FAO in Rome and ILO in Geneva.
accepted.tq: Start from a certain headquarters pair and eliminate swapped locations.
accepted.sec: International organisation → headquarters + head (UN bodies, IMF, UNEP, FAO, UNESCO, WHO, WTO, ILO)

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. UNESCO was established in 1945.
2. UNESCO has 194 members and 12 associate members.
3. Its Executive Board consists of 58 members.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: UNESCO dates from 1945, has 194 members and 12 associate members, and has a 58-member Executive Board.
accepted.tq: Test date, membership and composition together, with the complete combination as an option.
accepted.sec: International organisation → headquarters + head (UN bodies, IMF, UNEP, FAO, UNESCO, WHO, WTO, ILO)

accepted.s: Who among the following is the Director-General of the World Health Organization?
accepted.x: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is the Director-General of WHO, whose headquarters is in Geneva.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between heads of closely related international organisations.
accepted.sec: International organisation → headquarters + head (UN bodies, IMF, UNEP, FAO, UNESCO, WHO, WTO, ILO)

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: IAEA is headed by Rafael Grossi. Arsenio Dominguez is the Secretary-General of the IMO, headquartered in London.
accepted.tq: Find the wrong head attached to an otherwise plausible headquarters pair.
accepted.sec: International organisation → headquarters + head (UN bodies, IMF, UNEP, FAO, UNESCO, WHO, WTO, ILO)

accepted.s: Qu Dongyu, the Director-General of the FAO, belongs to which country?
accepted.x: Qu Dongyu is from China. India is also a founding member of FAO.
accepted.tq: Use nationality as the decisive discriminator among organisation heads.
accepted.sec: International organisation → headquarters + head (UN bodies, IMF, UNEP, FAO, UNESCO, WHO, WTO, ILO)

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) is correct?
o: It is headquartered in London and deals with maritime affairs.
It was established in 1865, is the oldest UN agency, has 194 members, and India joined in 1869.
It was established in 1944 and India joined it in 1945.
It is headquartered in Montreal and has a 36-member Council.
accepted.x: ITU was established in 1865, is the oldest UN agency, has 194 members and India joined in 1869.
accepted.tq: Combine establishment year, membership and India-specific chronology to identify the precise option.
accepted.sec: International organisation → headquarters + head (UN bodies, IMF, UNEP, FAO, UNESCO, WHO, WTO, ILO)

accepted.s: The 36-member Council is associated with which organisation?
accepted.x: ICAO, established in 1944 under the Chicago Convention, has a 36-member Council and is headquartered in Montreal.
accepted.tq: Match the distinctive numerical composition with the correct organisation.
accepted.sec: International organisation → headquarters + head (UN bodies, IMF, UNEP, FAO, UNESCO, WHO, WTO, ILO)

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about the International Monetary Fund is correct?
o: It is headquartered in Shanghai and has no country veto.
It is headquartered in Washington, D.C., and formally came into existence on 27 December 1945.
It was established by the Fortaleza Declaration of 2014.
It was established under the Chicago Convention in 1944.
accepted.x: The IMF is headquartered in Washington, D.C.; it originated at Bretton Woods in 1944 and formally came into existence on 27 December 1945.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the IMF from other institutions by headquarters and founding chronology.
accepted.sec: International organisation → headquarters + head (UN bodies, IMF, UNEP, FAO, UNESCO, WHO, WTO, ILO)

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?

1. New Development Bank — Shanghai — no country holds a veto
2. UNFCCC Secretariat — Bonn — 198 Parties
3. UN Alliance of Civilizations — New York — established in 2005 by Türkiye and Spain
accepted.x: All three pairs are correct. The New Development Bank dates from 2014, while the UN Alliance of Civilizations was launched in 2005 by Türkiye and Spain.
accepted.tq: Verify the repeated headquarters pattern before checking the institutional details.
accepted.sec: International organisation → headquarters + head (UN bodies, IMF, UNEP, FAO, UNESCO, WHO, WTO, ILO)

accepted.s:
Which of the following organisations are headquartered in Geneva?
1. WHO
2. ITU
3. WMO
4. WTO
5. ILO
accepted.x: WHO, ITU, WMO, WTO and ILO are all headquartered in Geneva.
accepted.tq: Group organisations by a common headquarters and test the complete set.
accepted.sec: International organisation → headquarters + head (UN bodies, IMF, UNEP, FAO, UNESCO, WHO, WTO, ILO)

accepted.s: The Secretary-General of the International Maritime Organization is:
accepted.x: Arsenio Dominguez of Panama is the Secretary-General of IMO, headquartered in London.
accepted.tq: Apply the head-to-organisation matching method using nearby international-office holders as distractors.
accepted.sec: Heads of organisations - newly appointed/elected, nationality, term

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the proposed transition of the United Nations Secretary-General's office?
o: The successor takes office only after approval by the IMF.
Guterres demits office at the end of 2026, and the successor's five-year term begins on 1 January 2027.
Guterres demits office in 2025, and the successor's term begins in August 2026.
The successor is elected directly by the Security Council for a four-year term.
accepted.x: António Guterres is scheduled to demit office at the end of 2026; the successor's five-year term is to begin on 1 January 2027.
accepted.tq: Separate office-holder, transition date and term length from the appointment procedure.
accepted.sec: Heads of organisations - newly appointed/elected, nationality, term

accepted.s: The election of Khalilur Rahman as the 81st UN General Assembly President represented the turn of which regional group?
accepted.x: The 2026–27 presidency was the turn of the Asia-Pacific Group. Khalilur Rahman defeated Cyprus.
accepted.tq: Link a regional rotation with the office-holder rather than confusing it with nationality alone.
accepted.sec: Heads of organisations - newly appointed/elected, nationality, term

accepted.s: Which one of the following nationality pairs is correctly matched?
o: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus — Ethiopia; Qu Dongyu — China
Celeste Saulo — Panama; Arsenio Dominguez — Argentina
Qu Dongyu — Argentina; Celeste Saulo — China
accepted.x: Tedros is Ethiopian and Qu Dongyu is Chinese. Celeste Saulo and Rafael Grossi are Argentine, while Arsenio Dominguez is Panamanian.
accepted.tq: Use paired nationalities to eliminate deliberate cross-swaps among organisation heads.
accepted.sec: Heads of organisations - newly appointed/elected, nationality, term

accepted.s: The International Solar Alliance was launched by which countries at COP21 in 2015?
accepted.x: The International Solar Alliance was sponsored by India and France at COP21 in 2015; its secretariat is at Gurugram.
accepted.tq: Match an initiative with its founding sponsors and launch occasion.
accepted.sec: Initiatives and scientific bodies - sponsor, secretariat, objective

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding the International Solar Alliance is correct?
1. It is open to all UN members.
2. Its secretariat is located at Gurugram.
3. Romania ratified its Framework Agreement in 2026.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Alliance is open to all UN members, has its secretariat at Gurugram and received Romania's ratification in 2026.
accepted.tq: Combine objective, location and recent membership-related development in one coded question.
accepted.sec: Initiatives and scientific bodies - sponsor, secretariat, objective

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Kimberley Process — conflict-diamond certification — no headquarters
Global Biofuels Alliance — India's G20 — biofuels
accepted.x: CDRI was sponsored by India in 2019 and is headquartered in New Delhi. Japan and Tokyo are not its sponsor and secretariat combination.
accepted.tq: Detect the swapped sponsor and location in an initiative-based pairing.
accepted.sec: Initiatives and scientific bodies - sponsor, secretariat, objective

accepted.s: The Kimberley Process is primarily associated with:
accepted.x: The Kimberley Process, established in 2003 by governments, industry and civil society, operates the Kimberley Process Certification Scheme for conflict diamonds and has no headquarters.
accepted.tq: Infer the initiative from its stated objective rather than from its institutional participants.
accepted.sec: Initiatives and scientific bodies - sponsor, secretariat, objective

accepted.s: The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) is jointly sponsored by:
accepted.x: The IPCC is sponsored by UNEP and WMO. Its AR6 synthesis report was released on 20 March 2023, and its AR7 cycle began in July 2023.
accepted.tq: Match the scientific body with its sponsoring organisations.
accepted.sec: Initiatives and scientific bodies - sponsor, secretariat, objective

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes POWERR Asia?
o: A Japan-sponsored initiative under AZEC Plus, launched in April 2026 for energy resilience, with India as a participant
A UNEP climate assessment cycle beginning in July 2023
An India-sponsored food-security programme launched at WTO MC14
An FAO treaty on plant genetic resources
accepted.x: POWERR Asia was sponsored by Japan under AZEC Plus in April 2026, focuses on energy resilience and includes India as a participant.
accepted.tq: Combine sponsor, framework, date, objective and participation in a single identification question.
accepted.sec: Initiatives and scientific bodies - sponsor, secretariat, objective

accepted.s: The International Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture, also known as the “Seed Treaty”, is sponsored by:
accepted.x: The ITPGRFA is sponsored by FAO and concerns plant genetic resources in harmony with the Convention on Biological Diversity.
accepted.tq: Use the common name and objective to identify the sponsoring organisation.
accepted.sec: Initiatives and scientific bodies - sponsor, secretariat, objective

accepted.s: Which United Nations peacekeeping mission is located in South Sudan, with its headquarters at Juba?
accepted.x: UNMISS is the United Nations Mission in South Sudan and is based at Juba.
accepted.tq: Expand the acronym and match it with the host country.
accepted.sec: UN peacekeeping missions → acronym + host country

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about UNMISS:
1. It operates in South Sudan.
2. India is its largest troop contributor, with 1,775 troops.
3. Two hundred and ten Indian peacekeepers received the UN Medal in August 2026.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. UNMISS is in South Sudan, India is its largest troop contributor with 1,775 troops, and 210 Indian peacekeepers received the UN Medal in August 2026.
accepted.tq: Test mission location, troop contribution and a numerical recent-development detail together.
accepted.sec: UN peacekeeping missions → acronym + host country

accepted.s: UNIFIL is associated with which of the following locations?
o: The Golan Heights, where it began in 1974
South Sudan, where it began in 2011
The Democratic Republic of the Congo, where it began in 1999
Lebanon, where it has operated since 1978
accepted.x: UNIFIL is the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon and has operated there since 1978. An end to the force has been forecast.
accepted.tq: Distinguish peacekeeping acronyms by host country and start date.
accepted.sec: UN peacekeeping missions → acronym + host country

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: MONUSCO — Democratic Republic of the Congo
accepted.x: MONUSCO operates in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. UNDOF is associated with the Golan Heights in Syria, UNIFIL with Lebanon and UNMISS with South Sudan.
accepted.tq: Use the sure acronym-country pair and eliminate host-country swaps.
accepted.sec: UN peacekeeping missions → acronym + host country

accepted.s: The United Nations Disengagement Observer Force (UNDOF) is deployed in:
o: The Democratic Republic of the Congo
accepted.x: UNDOF is deployed in the Golan Heights, Syria.
accepted.tq: Test the expansion of the acronym against the distinctive geographic location.
accepted.sec: UN peacekeeping missions → acronym + host country
